hbs.title: State-wise Medium & Small Scale Industries - Total Number of Units

meta.coverage: State-wise Medium & Small Scale Industries - Total Number of Units: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 134
meta.note: DBIE report 1678, data provider "Query 1". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor). Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: none; measures: value. Andhra Pradesh before 2014-15 is the undivided state, a separate series (Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014; 2014-15 straddles the split).
